List every Paralympic Games in which the Australian men's wheelchair basketball team (the Rollers) won a medal, giving the year, host city, and exact medal type (gold/silver/bronze) for each tournament.

List national-level wheelchair basketball development programs, pathways, or academies in Australia (for example government, AIS, state institutes, national junior programs or elite academies), give the formal program name and the year each program or academy was established or launched.

Which offensive and defensive tactical systems, set plays, tempo-control strategies, full-court or half-court defensive schemes, or coaching innovations have analysts, match reports, or coaches attributed specifically to the Australian Rollers, and in which games, tournaments or time periods were these tactics documented?

Which documented disputes, legal challenges, classification appeals, or media exposés have questioned the classification status of specific Australian Rollers players (name incidents, dates, and outcomes)?

Provide the founding date or first organizational formation of the Australian men's wheelchair basketball program (the Rollers) and describe key institutional milestones or restructures (e.g., establishment of national governing links, professionalization, national training centre openings, or major governance reforms) with year-by-year detail.

Identify the Rollers players and head coaches most frequently referenced in authoritative sources (e.g., Hall of Fame entries, Paralympic reports, major sports historians): list each person and summarize their main accomplishments (medals, championships, awards, tenure years, records).

Which nationwide development pathways, state academies, or dedicated wheelchair basketball training institutes in Australia have been created to support elite male players; give each program or academy name, the year it was launched, its sponsoring body, and its primary purpose or offerings.

What offensive and defensive systems, set plays, zone vs man-to-man adjustments, coaching philosophies, or tactical innovations have analysts or match reports credited to the Australian Rollers in major tournaments (Paralympics, World Championships, Asia Oceania qualifiers)?

Which specific models of sports wheelchairs, seating and strapping setups, wheel and tire technologies, and bespoke equipment modifications have been used by the Rollers over time, and when were major equipment changes or technology adoptions first reported?
